name: @pipeworx/mcp-quickbooks

tools.name: qb_query
tools.description: Execute a QuickBooks SQL-like query (QBO query language) against any entity type — Customer, Invoice, Account, etc. Example: "SELECT * FROM Customer MAXRESULTS 10". Returns raw QuickBooks API response with matching records.

query.description: QuickBooks SQL-like query string (e.g., "SELECT * FROM Customer MAXRESULTS 10")

tools.name: qb_get_customer
tools.description: Retrieve a customer's complete profile including contact info, email, phone, and account balance by customer ID.

tools.name: qb_list_invoices
tools.description: Get recent invoices with number, customer, amount, due date, and payment status. Use qb_get_invoice for full line-item details.

max_results.description: Maximum number of invoices to return (default 25, max 1000)

tools.name: qb_get_invoice
tools.description: Retrieve a complete invoice by ID including all line items, amounts, taxes, and payment history.

tools.name: qb_list_accounts
tools.description: Get your chart of accounts with account names, types (asset/liability/equity/etc), balances, and classifications.

max_results.description: Maximum number of accounts to return (default 100, max 1000)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-quickbooks forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the quickbooks pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
